Name: REINFORCE_PARAM_WEAPON_ST
Description: Defines upgrades of weapons, include stat changes and upgrade cost (EquipMtrlSetParam id offset)

Fields.Name: Damage %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base physical attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base magic attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base fire attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base lightning attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Stamina
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base stamina attack (stamina damage dealt to a guarding target) at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Poise
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's poise damage at this level.

Fields.Name: Poise Durability
Fields.Description: SA endurance correction value

Fields.Name: Correction %: STR
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Strength scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too.

Fields.Name: Correction %: DEX
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Dexterity scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too.

Fields.Name: Correction %: INT
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Intelligence scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too.

Fields.Name: Correction %: FTH
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Faith scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Physical
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's physical guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Magic
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's magic guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Fire
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's fire guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Lightning
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's lightning guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Poison
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's poison guard resistance (how much buildup is blocked when guarding) at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's scarlet rot guard resistance at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's blood loss guard resistance at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Death Blight
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's death blight guard resistance at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Boost %
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's guard boost (stamina defence when guarding) at this level.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [1] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 1 ID at this level, so each level can use its own SpEffect row.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [2] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 2 ID at this level.

Fields.Name: Behavior SpEffect [3] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Behavior SpEffect 3 ID at this level.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [1] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 1 ID at this level.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [2] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 2 ID at this level.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect [3] Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Passive SpEffect 3 ID at this level.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Material Set Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the weapon's Reinforcement Material Set ID to pick the EquipMtrlSetParam row of materials needed to upgrade to this level.

Fields.Name: Matchmaking Upgrade Level
Fields.Description: The level this row counts as on the regular 0-25 scale. The game records the highest value among the weapons the player has obtained and uses it (capped at 25) for multiplayer matchmaking against GameSystemCommonParam's weapon-level limits.

Fields.Name: Damage %: Holy
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's base holy attack at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Holy
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's holy guard damage negation at this level.

Fields.Name: Correction %: ARC
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's Arcane scaling at this level. An affinity's scaling override (AttackElementCorrectParam) is multiplied by it too.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Frostbite
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's frostbite guard resistance at this level.

Fields.Name: Reinforce Price Rate
Fields.Description: Correction value to multiply the enhancement price of the weapon parameter

Fields.Name: Base Change Price Rate
Fields.Description: Correction value to multiply the evolution price of the weapon parameter

Fields.Name: Ash of War Rank
Fields.Description: Mountable magic stone rank

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Sleep
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's sleep guard resistance at this level.

Fields.Name: Guard Resist %: Madness
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the weapon's madness guard resistance at this level.

Fields.Name: Damage %: BaseAtk
Fields.Description: Damage multiplier for attacks with isAddBaseAtk in AtkParam, typically used with Ash of Wars.

Fields.Name: Stat Scaling Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the attack's stat-scaling bonus (the part added by STR/DEX/INT/FTH/ARC scaling) at this upgrade level. Retail: 1 except on staves and seals, where it rises with the level (Glintstone Staff +1 1.176, +2 1.344, +3 1.52).
